title: Is fashion a waste of money?
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás ELLEN érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Following fashion trends is a waste of time and money
candidateIdeas: Clothes are a way of expressing your personality and creativity.
Looking good can increase self-confidence, especially for teenagers.
Following fashion does not have to be expensive: second-hand shops and clothes swaps are popular.
Fashion is part of culture and reflects social change.
The fashion industry creates millions of jobs.
examinerArguments: Fast fashion is one of the most polluting industries in the world.
Trends change so quickly that clothes are out of date after a few months.
Teenagers feel pressure to buy brands, and those who can't afford them may be bullied.
Your personality is shown by what you do, not by what you wear.
The money could be spent on experiences, education or saving for the future.

followUpQuestions: But fast fashion is terrible for the environment. How can you defend that?
Don't you think young people feel too much pressure to wear expensive brands?
Isn't it better to spend money on travel or experiences than on clothes?

usefulPhrases.hu: Ez nem feltétlenül jelenti azt, hogy ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Here's the statement: 'Following fashion trends is a waste of time and money.' What do you think?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I disagree. For many people, especially teenagers, clothes are a way of expressing their personality and creativity. When you feel good about the way you look, it can give you a real boost of self-confidence – before our school-leaving ball, choosing my outfit was half the fun. And fashion is part of culture, too: it reflects how society changes.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: But fast fashion is terrible for the environment. How can you defend that?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I'm not defending fast fashion – I agree that it's one of the most polluting industries in the world. But following trends doesn't have to mean buying cheap clothes every week. Second-hand shops and clothes swaps are really popular among my friends, and that's both trendy and sustainable.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Don't you think young people feel too much pressure to wear expensive brands?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That's true, unfortunately, and students who can't afford brands are sometimes even bullied. But that's a problem of peer pressure, not of fashion itself. Real style is about combining things creatively, and you can look great on a small budget.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Isn't it better to spend money on travel or experiences than on clothes?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Both can be valuable, so I'd say it's a question of balance. Nobody should spend all their savings on clothes, but buying a few pieces you really love isn't a waste. And let's not forget that the fashion industry creates millions of jobs, from designers to tailors in small workshops.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó végig az állítás ellen érvel (önkifejezés, önbizalom, kultúra, munkahelyek), saját élményt említ (szalagavató), a fast fashionnél elismeri a jogos kritikát, majd megoldást mutat (használtruha-boltok, ruhacsere), az utolsó ellenérvnél pedig az egyensúlyt hangsúlyozza.

Szókincs: gazdag, témához illő szókincs (self-confidence, outfit, clothes swaps, peer pressure, sustainable) és árnyalt vitanyelv (I'm not defending …; That's true, unfortunately, … But …; it's a question of balance).
Nyelvhelyesség: változatos és pontos B2-es szerkezetek – szenvedő szerkezet (are sometimes even bullied), 'doesn't have to mean', 'When you feel …, it can …' és 'let's not forget that …'.
Érdemes megtanulni: „a real boost of self-confidence”, „both trendy and sustainable”, „on a small budget”, „let's not forget that”.
